material.subject: U1: do gate checks or any consumer enumerate rust/data recursively, so a new subdirectory changes their result?
material.witness_evidence: probe 1792144437978: codesearch regex read_dir|walkdir over rust/ (85 files) returns one hit, rust/crates/data/src/lib.rs:26 read_dir, non-recursive, filter ext==star. No recursive walker. Expected: no recursive consumer. Observed: match.
